note: Factors are data, never constants in code. ACS 5-year dollars are in the end year's dollars (2006-2010 in 2010 dollars), so factor(2010 -> 2020) = annual[2020] / annual[2010] = 1.1906. The Philadelphia study used 1.187, 0.3% lower; it stays a fixture to explain at Phase 04 (an earlier BLS revision or rounding), not a value to use.
